projects.project_name: KETTLE CREEK PRIMARY - PINE GROVE PRIMARY 115KV REBUILD
uncertainties: The project title indicates line endpoints between Kettle Creek Primary and Pine Grove Primary, but the project description specifies rebuild work only for approximately 38.04 miles from Pine Grove to the Pearson tap.
Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidential markings restricting duplication and disclosure.
Project cost estimates and supporting statement are redacted.
Project schedule changed from previous Ten Year Plan (delayed from 2029 to 2030).

evidence.text: KETTLE CREEK PRIMARY - PINE GROVE PRIMARY 115KV REBUILD
Rebuild approximately 38.04 miles of 50C 4/0 ACSR conductor from the Pine Grove to the Pearson tap using 200C 1351 ACSS conductor.
